title: Enhanced External Counterpulsation on Delayed Onset Muscle Soreness
brief_summary: This study will evaluate the effects of Enhanced External Counterpulsation on delayed onset muscle soreness. The primary outcomes will be duration of delayed onset muscle soreness, WBC count, CRP count, CPK count, and pain tolerance.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy active Duty or DoD beneficiaries between 25 and 59 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not on a physical profile
* Not taking any OTC or prescription pain medications or workout supplements
